external_entities.name: calling service
external_entities.description: An other team's backend that calls the inference gateway.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
external_entities.notes: Two of the calling services are in a different cloud. API keys are issued per calling team and have never been expired.

external_entities.name: calling team's user
external_entities.description: A user whose typed prompt may be carried in a request.
external_entities.source_excerpt: raw prompts, which sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed

external_entities.name: ML engineer
external_entities.description: An engineer who publishes model artifacts to the registry bucket.
external_entities.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket

processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: A FastAPI service that receives inference requests and forwards them to the model server.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE
processes.notes: Callers pass an API key in a header. Keys are issued per calling team and have never expired one.

processes.name: model server
processes.description: The server that runs the actual model on GPU nodes and reads model artifacts and customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network
processes.notes: There is no auth between the gateway and the model server. The server uses its own service account to load model artifacts. The text says it is not believed that anything verifies whether an artifact has been swapped and that the bucket is trusted.

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket containing model artifacts loaded by the model server at startup.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup
data_stores.notes: The text says: "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: A Redis store containing customer features including account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The features include account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.notes: Redis has no password and is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing every request and response for debugging, including raw prompts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery
data_stores.notes: Raw prompts sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.

data_flows.notes: There is no auth between the gateway and the model server.

data_flows.name: load artifacts
data_flows.description: The model server loads model artifacts from the registry bucket at startup.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup

data_flows.name: read features
data_flows.description: The model server reads customer features from the Redis feature store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the model server reads from a Redis feature store on the same network
data_flows.notes: Redis has no password on it.
data_flows.data_description: Customer features including account age and spend bands per customer

data_flows.data_description: Requests and responses, including raw prompts

data_flows.notes: The text says: "I'm not sure what governs who can push — I think it is a shared group account." This is a voiced uncertainty, so authentication remains unknown.
